label: Accessible witness preservation rules out being without a source of dependence (inference)
rule: Preserve a realized contrast witness, which then contradicts selected absence soundness
meaning: Conditional support at the same origin. If a dependent effect could exist without its source, realization gives an accessible contrast witness. Preservation supplies a selected accessible contrast witness for the same pair. Dependence soundness excludes the effect there, contradicting its presence. This uses only witness preservation alongside the original realization and soundness premises.
